title: Atlas DataFlow Published Dataset Context
description: Public context contract for a published Atlas DataFlow dataset. Defines the public-safe narrative and descriptive metadata associated with a dataset. This schema is not a CMS, authoring system, or admin interface. It does not carry internal run evidence, preparation details, metrics internals, publication evidence, or operational traceability fields. dataset_slug is the primary public identity and must match the registry slug pattern — it is not replaced or aliased by this contract.

schema_version.title: Context Schema Version
schema_version.description: Semantic version of this context schema structure in MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH format (e.g., "1.0.0"). Required. Independent from the runtime contract schema_version — each contract type versions its own schema structure separately.

dataset_slug.title: Dataset Slug
dataset_slug.description: Primary public identity of the dataset. Must match the registry slug pattern: lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and single hyphen separators. Carried from the registry — do not encode local paths, private names, release details, or alternate routing semantics in this field.

title.title: Dataset Title
title.description: Public-safe display title for the dataset. Required. Intended as the human-readable name shown to users in the public experience.

description.title: Dataset Description
description.description: Public-safe short description of what the dataset represents and what the associated model predicts. Required. Must not include internal evidence, raw metrics, or pipeline details.

domain.title: Dataset Domain
domain.description: Domain category for the dataset (e.g., telco, finance, health, retail). Required. Used for public discovery and grouping. Must not introduce alternate routing semantics or replace dataset_slug as the primary identity.

tags.title: Dataset Tags
tags.description: Optional list of public-safe tags for discovery and grouping. Each tag must be a non-empty string. May be an empty array or absent.

short_narrative.title: Short Narrative
short_narrative.description: Optional public-safe brief narrative explaining what the model does and how users should understand the prediction experience. Must not include internal evidence or operational details.

long_narrative.title: Long Narrative
long_narrative.description: Optional public-safe extended narrative for richer dataset context pages. Must not include internal evidence, run details, or operational traceability.
